meta.name: Super Man The Christopher Reeve Story
meta.description: Christopher Reeve portrayed the Man of Steel in four Superman films and played dozens of other roles that displayed his talent and range as an actor, before being injured in a near-fatal horse-riding accident in 1995 that left him paralyzed from the neck down. After becoming a quadriplegic, he became a charismatic leader and activist in the quest to find a cure for spinal cord injuries, as well as a passionate advocate for disability rights and care.
meta.slogan: Husband. Father. Fighter. Hero. Once you choose hope, anything is possible.
